description: Generate a verified Bitcoin Core Merkle inclusion receipt for one to five transactions in one retained block. locator=blockhash:txid[,txid...]. Verify against a trusted header chain. Does not establish unspentness or irreversible finality. Price: 20 sats or US$0.02 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

locator.description: 64-character block hash, colon, and one to five comma-separated unique transaction ids in that block.

pass.description: Optional. A Diamond budget token (dp_...) that your user approved once (from US$0.89; USDC or other Base tokens, or Lightning) or that you funded with the free diamond_budget tool. Each call deducts its price; no wallet needed in the agent.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

name: verify
title: Verify transaction inclusion receipt
